This patchfile contains:

 - areas.dm reduced to only *necessary* areas (code-dependencies)
 - Space Station 13 areas.dm created in the maps/ directory, with basic
instructions and all the map-dependent areas included
 - areas.dmi icon file updated
 - All the areas now have icons (some not too distinct, but it does the
job), have been reorganized and relabelled to make sense for the new map
 - Changelog updated to Revision 172
Oh, also includes the latest map updated with area changes.

I also labelled in areas.dm where the dependencies were if someone wanted to later go
and remove or reduce them.

I suck at patching apparantly doesn't work for binaries, uploading files to my FTP
site for manual integration
